units.source_text: 那个八十多岁的母尼僧隐约听见了笛声，也很想欣赏，便从里面走出来。

en.t: The mother nun, who was over eighty, faintly heard the flute and wanted to enjoy it too, so she came out from inside.

units.source_text: 她的话声颤抖得厉害，又不断地咳嗽。

en.t: Her voice trembled badly, and she kept coughing.

units.source_text: 她并不谈起往事，大约没有认清楚这是她的外孙女婿吧。

en.t: She did not speak of the past, probably because she had not recognized him as her granddaughter's husband.

units.source_text: 她对女儿说道：“喂喂，来弹七弦琴吧。

en.t: She said to her daughter, "Come now, play the seven-stringed zither.

units.source_text: 月夜吹横笛实在很有情趣。

en.t: Playing the flute on a moonlit night is truly full of charm.

units.source_text: 怎么样？

en.t: What do you think?

units.source_text: 侍女们！

en.t: Ladies in waiting!

units.source_text: 拿七弦琴来！”

en.t: Bring the seven-stringed zither!"

units.source_text: 中将在帘外推想这是那母尼僧。

en.t: Outside the curtain, the Captain guessed that this must be the mother nun.

units.source_text: 他想：“这样年老的人不知一向住在什么地方，怎么会活到今天的？

en.t: He thought, "Where has such an old woman been living all this time, and how has she survived until now?

units.source_text: 她的外孙女反而先死。

en.t: Her granddaughter died before her instead.

units.source_text: 人世夭寿无定，真乃可悲之事。”

en.t: In this world, long life and early death are uncertain; it is truly a sorrowful thing."

units.source_text: 便在笛上用盘涉调吹出一个美妙的乐曲。

en.t: Then he played a beautiful piece on the flute in the Banshiki mode.

units.source_text: 曲罢说道：“怎么样？

en.t: When the piece ended, he said, "How was that?

units.source_text: 现在请弹七弦琴吧。”

en.t: Now please play the seven-stringed zither."

units.source_text: 妹尼僧本来是个颇爱风流的人，说道：“你的笛声比我以前听到的美妙得多，

en.t: The younger nun had always been someone who loved elegance, and she said, "Your flute sounds far more beautiful than any I heard before,

units.source_text: 想是我的耳朵听惯了山风之声的缘故吧。”

en.t: perhaps because my ears have grown used to the sound of the mountain wind."

units.source_text: 又说：“啊呀，我的琴怕弹得不入调呢。”

en.t: Then she added, "Oh dear, I fear my zither may be out of tune."

units.source_text: 说罢就弹。

en.t: With that, she began to play.

units.source_text: 时下的习俗，一般人爱弹七弦琴的日渐稀少，因此倒觉得她的琴声新颖可喜。

en.t: In the fashion of the day, fewer and fewer people cared to play the seven-stringed zither, so her music seemed fresh and pleasing.

units.source_text: 松风之声与琴声相和合。

en.t: The sound of the wind in the pines blended with the sound of the zither.

units.source_text: 月亮似乎也跟着琴声而清澄起来。

en.t: Even the moon seemed to grow clearer along with the zither's notes.

units.source_text: 那老尼僧越发感动，深夜也不想睡，只管坐着听赏。

en.t: The old nun was moved all the more, and even late at night she had no wish to sleep, but simply sat listening with delight.

units.source_text: 她说：“我这老太婆年轻时也曾好好地弹过和琴。

en.t: She said, "When this old woman was young, I too used to play the wagon properly.

units.source_text: 但恐现世此琴的弹法已经改变，所以我家那僧都阻止我，

en.t: But fearing that the way this instrument is played has changed in the present age, the priest in my family stopped me,

units.source_text: 他说：‘母亲的和琴弹得真难听！

en.t: saying, 'Mother's wagon playing is truly hard to listen to!

units.source_text: 老年人除了念佛之外，不要干这些无聊的事吧！’

en.t: Old people should do nothing but recite the Buddha's name, and not busy themselves with such idle things!'

units.source_text: 我被他这么一说，就不弹了。

en.t: After he said that to me, I stopped playing.

units.source_text: 但我藏着一张声音极美的和琴呢。”

en.t: But I have a wagon hidden away that has an exceptionally beautiful sound."

units.source_text: 看她的样子很想一试其技。

en.t: From the look of her, she very much wanted to try her skill.

units.source_text: 中将在帘外偷偷地笑，对她说道：“僧都阻止你，太没道理了！

en.t: Outside the curtain, the Captain laughed quietly and said to her, "It was quite unreasonable of the priest to stop you!

units.source_text: 所谓极乐净土之中，菩萨们也都演奏音乐，

en.t: In the Pure Land of Bliss, as they say, even the bodhisattvas perform music,

units.source_text: 天人也表演舞蹈，都是很庄严的。

en.t: and heavenly beings perform dances; all of it is most solemn and splendid.

units.source_text: 这怎么会妨碍修行，获得罪障呢？

en.t: How could that hinder religious practice or bring about sinful obstruction?

units.source_text: 今夜定要听一听岳祖母的妙技！”

en.t: Tonight I must by all means hear Grandmother-in-law's marvelous skill!"

units.source_text: 老尼僧被他这么一捧，更加兴致勃勃，叫道：“喂，主殿！

en.t: Encouraged by his praise, the old nun grew still more enthusiastic and called out, "Hey, Toneri!

units.source_text: 把我的和琴拿来！”

en.t: Bring me my wagon!"

units.source_text: 说时咳嗽不绝。

en.t: As she spoke, she coughed without stopping.

units.source_text: 旁人都觉得难堪，但念僧都阻止她弹和琴，

en.t: Everyone around her felt embarrassed, but when they thought how the priest had stopped her from playing the wagon,

units.source_text: 她尚且要痛恨而向人诉苦，

en.t: and how she still resented it enough to complain to others,

units.source_text: 这老妇实甚可怜，便听其所为。

en.t: they felt the old woman was truly pitiful and let her do as she pleased.

units.source_text: 和琴取到之后，她也不配合刚才的笛声的调子，

en.t: After the wagon was brought, she did not match the mode of the flute from before,

units.source_text: 只管任意在和琴上拨弄曲调。

en.t: but simply plucked out melodies on the wagon however she liked.

units.source_text: 此时别的乐器都停止了，

en.t: At this point all the other instruments stopped,

units.source_text: 她自以为他们是要单独欣赏她的和琴之故，

en.t: and she thought it was because they wanted to enjoy her wagon alone,

units.source_text: 便得意扬扬地用迅速的拍子反复弹奏几句歌词的曲调：

en.t: so, in high spirits, she repeatedly played the melody of a few lyric phrases in a rapid beat:

units.source_text: “塔里当那，契里契里塔里当那……”

en.t: "Tari tanna, chiri chiri tari tanna..."

units.source_text: 真是奇怪的古风。

en.t: It was a truly strange old-fashioned style.

units.source_text: 中将赞道：“弹得好极了！

en.t: The Captain praised her, saying, "That was wonderfully played!

units.source_text: 这是现今世人不曾听到过的歌调。”

en.t: This is a song style that people today have never heard before."

units.source_text: 她的耳朵重听，问了旁人才明白，

en.t: She was hard of hearing, and only understood after asking someone nearby,

units.source_text: 便说道：“现今年轻人都不喜欢这种音乐吧。

en.t: then said, "Young people these days must not like this kind of music.

units.source_text: 几个月之前来到这里的那位小姐，相貌生得非常漂亮，

en.t: The young lady who came here several months ago was born with an extremely beautiful face,

units.source_text: 然而完全不懂得这种风雅之事，

en.t: but she understands nothing at all of such elegant pursuits,

units.source_text: 只是一天到晚躲在房间里呢。”

en.t: and only hides in her room from morning to night."

units.source_text: 她自以为贤明，在中将面前非笑浮舟，

en.t: Thinking herself wise, she mocked Ukifune in front of the Captain,

units.source_text: 妹尼僧等都觉得难堪。

en.t: and the younger nun and the others all felt embarrassed.

units.source_text: 老尼僧弹和琴尽兴之后，中将就告辞返京。

en.t: After the old nun had played the wagon to her heart's content, the Captain took his leave and returned to the capital.

units.source_text: 他一路上吹笛，

en.t: He played the flute along the road,

units.source_text: 山风把笛声送到草庵里来，

en.t: and the mountain wind carried the sound of the flute into the thatched hermitage,

units.source_text: 闻者无不赞叹，竟彻夜未眠，坐以待旦。

en.t: so that everyone who heard it was filled with admiration, and they ended up sitting awake all night until dawn.
